user.title: Price Data Source
user.description: Configure the entity that provides energy price data.

data_description.price_entity_id: Sensor entity whose attributes contain the price list (e.g. sensor.nordpool_kwh_be_eur_3).
data_description.price_attribute: Attribute name that holds the list of price entries (default: data).
data_description.start_key: Key inside each price entry that holds the slot start time (default: start).
data_description.price_key: Key inside each price entry that holds the price value (default: price).
data_description.injection_price_key: Key for the sell-back / injection price. Leave empty if not available.

battery.title: Battery Configuration
battery.description: Optional battery settings for SoC prediction and optimisation.

data_description.battery_entity_id: Number or sensor entity that reports the current State of Charge in %.
data_description.battery_size_kwh: Usable capacity of the battery in kWh.
data_description.roundtrip_loss_pct: Energy lost in a full charge-discharge cycle (default: 20 %).

devices.title: Schedulable Devices
devices.description:
Devices the EMS can schedule alongside the battery (heat pump, boiler, aircon, ...). Each one gets a binary sensor that turns on while it is scheduled; drive the real appliance from an automation on that entity.

Configured: {devices}

device_add.title: Add Device
device_add.description: Describe a device the EMS should be able to schedule.

data_description.name: Shown in the dashboard card and used as the service call's device_name.
data_description.control: Wattage: you set the power per slot. On/off: no power entry at all. Modes: pick one of several named modes per slot.
data_description.modes: Only for the 'Modes' control. Type each mode and press enter, e.g. Eco, Comfort, Boost. Add a power figure with a colon (Comfort:1500) to make the battery forecast mode-aware.
data_description.default_wattage: Typical draw while running. Used as the load estimate in the battery forecast for on/off and mode devices, and as the pre-filled value for wattage devices. Set 0 if the draw is negligible.
data_description.switch_entity_id: The entity that actually turns the device on. Exposed as an attribute so one templated automation can drive every device.

device_remove.title: Remove Devices
device_remove.description: Select the devices to remove. Their scheduled slots stay in storage but are no longer applied.

error.invalid_entity: The selected entity does not exist in Home Assistant.
error.invalid_device_name: Enter a name for the device.
error.duplicate_device: A device with that name already exists.
error.modes_required: Add at least one mode, or pick a different control type.
